description: Start a durable local shadow runner that records intended orders and theoretical fills only. With evidence, promotionCriteria and paperModel together, the runner seals owner criteria for strategy_promotion_status and prepare. Never signs or broadcasts.

evidence.description: Full evidence artifact. With promotionCriteria and paperModel it is sealed into the runner.

paperModel.description: Fixed paper sizing and costs. Unset costs use the backtest defaults (3.5 taker, 2 builder, 2 slippage bps) and are sealed explicitly.

promotionCriteria.description: Owner-selected paper promotion criteria, sealed at start and immutable. Every threshold is required; none is defaulted.

name: strategy_shadow_start
